title: test_pbkdf2.rs: PBKDF2 via password-hash traits (PR #10305)
description:
Write tests/test_pbkdf2.rs: test password_hash::PasswordHasher PBKDF2 impl against Wycheproof JSON for HMAC-SHA-1/256/384/512.

## What
Verify PBKDF2 password-hash trait impl (PR #10305) computes byte-exact derived keys against Wycheproof vectors (superset of RFC 6070), demonstrating that the PR's round-trip-only tests are insufficient.

## Algorithm
1. For each variant in [hmacsha1, hmacsha256, hmacsha384, hmacsha512]:
   a. load external/wycheproof/testvectors_v1/pbkdf2_{variant}_test.json
   b. Parse: password (bytes), salt (bytes), iterations (u32), dkLen (usize), dk (expected bytes)
   c. use password_hash::{PasswordHasher, SaltString, Algorithm, Params};
   d. Construct Params with iter (c) and output length (dkLen)
   e. Call pbkdf2_impl.hash_password_into(password, salt, &mut output_buf) -> assert Ok
   f. assert_eq!(output_buf[..dkLen], expected_dk, 'PBKDF2-{} vector {} failed');
2. Invalid cases (if any in Wycheproof with result=='invalid'): assert Err returned.
3. Demonstrate the gap: add a comment before each test noting which cases are NOT in PR #10305's test suite (which only does round-trip: hash twice, compare).

## Defensive rules
- Password and derived key must never appear in test failure messages (key material discipline)
- If dkLen exceeds what the impl supports, document with #[ignore] and a gap comment
- If Wycheproof file missing (setup.sh not run), panic with clear message pointing to setup.sh
- Iterations count in Wycheproof may be large; set a per-test timeout warning if iterations > 10000

## Agent team
- Agent R: read pbkdf2_password_hash.rs (PR #10305) to find exact type name and which SHA variants are exposed; check what Params fields are expected; read Wycheproof JSON schema
- Agent I: write test_pbkdf2.rs per algorithm above
- Agent T: independently compute PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-1 of RFC 6070 §2 test 1 (password='password', salt='salt', c=1, dkLen=20) using Python: hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha1', b'password', b'salt', 1, 20).hex() = 0c60c80f961f0e71f3a9b524af6012062fe037a6

## Tests (oracles)
- Wycheproof pbkdf2_hmacsha1_test.json (superset of RFC 6070 §2 vectors)
- Wycheproof pbkdf2_hmacsha256_test.json
- Wycheproof pbkdf2_hmacsha384_test.json
- Wycheproof pbkdf2_hmacsha512_test.json
- RFC 6070 §2 Test Case 1: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1(password, salt, 1, 20) = 0c60c80f961f0e71f3a9b524af6012062fe037a6
